> The Hackpad is a self-contained, handheld cyberdeck designed for portable spectrum analysis, radio signal monitoring, and data packet decoding. Unlike standard laptops, it features an integrated broad-spectrum RF receiver, a compact daylight-readable screen, physical control inputs, and a modular antenna port—all enclosed in a ruggedized 3D-printed chassis.
